nodes.label: Out of scope: hard question limits during grilling
nodes.rationale: Grilling is intentionally open-ended: keep digging until each branch of the decision tree is resolved. A fixed cap conflates two failure modes - many questions because the plan is under-specified (working as intended) vs redundant questions (a prompt-quality issue). Natural-language steering is the intended control surface, not a numeric limit. Prior request: #44.
